items.title: An isomorphism of localisations of finitely presented algebras spreads out to an isomorphism after inverting one element
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that an isomorphism between the localisations of two finitely presented algebras at primes spreads out to an isomorphism after inverting a single element outside each prime (statement lines 31840-31849). The proof does not use a general limit argument: it compares the two explicit presentations, expresses the images of finitely many generators as fractions, clears the finitely many denominators to get the same algebra, and then reduces the remaining ambiguity by splitting off a factor (proof lines 31851-31877). Clearing denominators for the whole presentation at once is the step that carries the argument. H2.
